_comment: Which build each manual documents, and where to find it running.
`ref` is origin/staging, not origin/main. main is built by merging staging —
every recent merge into main is a PR 'from KazziGroup/staging' — so staging
holds the product decisions that are on their way to users, and main is a
This was main until 18 Sep 2026, and documenting it produced manuals for
gifts and subscriptions that staging had already deferred, while omitting the
email sign-in that staging had already added. A trailing branch is a fine
thing to deploy and a poor thing to document.
The ref is checked before anything is shot, because the alternative has
already happened: a figure was captured from a dev server left on an unmerged
feature branch and documented a screen that does not exist. Nothing about the
image showed it. `ALLOW_REF_DRIFT=1` overrides the check and records the drift
in every provenance file it produces.
`url` can be overridden per app with the named environment variable, because
dev servers move: these apps pick the next free port.

caretaker-mobile-app.refNote: main, not staging: this repo has no staging branch — origin/main is the only published ref it has.

caretaker-mobile-app-live.note: Expo dev client against the local backend — needs Metro on 8081 with EXPO_PUBLIC_API_PORT matching the API. The static-demo build cannot document signing in, because it opens already signed in.
